text: [98] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānassatiṃ bahulīkaronto nacirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati katamehi pañcahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu appaṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu appāhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto āraññako hoti pantasenāsano yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānassatiṃ bahulīkaronto nacirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhatīti .
